fields.Name: T149 - Predictive Studio Predictions Landing
fields.Description: Exercises the PredictiveStudioPredictionsResource (business front-door) app entry + its catalog-vs-capability-intro branch — a bespoke resource component, not the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and select 'Predictive Studio' — scroll the full app list if it isn't immediately visible. Land on the 'Predictions' door. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is seeing the Predictions business landing render: either a grid of prediction cards each with a trust badge (e.g. Good / Fair / Poor / Not ready), OR the first-run empty state titled 'Predict what's next for your data' with capability cards and a 'Build your first prediction' button. Either state is a pass — you do NOT need to open a card.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Predictive Studio app opens and the Predictions door renders with the header title 'Predictions'
Either prediction cards with trust badges are shown, OR the capability intro empty state with a 'Build your first prediction' call to action is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
